                                                   公司簡介
                                                   Corporate Profile



                                              綠城中國控股有限公司是中國領先的優質房產品開發及生活綜合服務供應商，以優秀的產品質量、獨特
                                              的建築美學、以人為本的服務保持行業領先地位。公司連續十八年榮獲「中國房地產百強企業綜合實力
                                              TOP10」，客戶滿意度連續十一年全國領先，獲多家行業主流機構「產品力第一」的權威認可，多年榮獲
                                              「社會責任感企業」等殊榮。



                                              Greentown China Holdings Limited is a leading quality property developer and integrated living service
                                              provider in China. It maintains a leadership position in the industry by virtue of the quality of its properties,
                                              its unique architectural aesthetics and customer centric services. The Company has been awarded the “Top10
                                              among 100 Chinese Real Estate Enterprises by Comprehensive Strength” for 18 consecutive years and named
                                              No.1 in customer satisfaction in the country for 11 consecutive years as well as recognized as “Product Strength
                                              First” by various mainstream organizations in the industry. It has also received such honors as “Enterprise with
                                              Social Responsibility” for many years.

                             董事會主席及執行董事                                                                                009
                             張亞東先生
                             Chairman of the Board
                             and Executive Director
                             Mr ZHANG Yadong



2021年，面對經濟下行、疫情衝擊、調控加碼、市場急凍、行業劇變的嚴峻挑戰，綠城中國呈現出逆勢
增長的良好態勢：榮獲國內國際設計營造大獎百餘項，產品力保持行業第一；全年完成合同銷售額人民
幣3,509億元，同比增長21%，業績增速位列TOP10房企第一；連續10年獲得「中國房地產顧客滿意度領先
品牌」，在2021居民居住滿意度調查中，綠城在14個城市位居滿意度第一，9個城市忠誠度第一。



In 2021, faced with the severe challenges of an economic downturn, impact of the pandemic, strengthened




                                                                                                                       Annual Report 2021 年報 二零二一年
regulatory measures, market freeze, and drastic changes in the industry, Greentown China showed a positive
momentum of growth that went against the trend: it won more than 100 domestic and international design
and construction awards with product strength remaining No. 1 in the industry; it achieved contracted sales of
RMB350.9 billion throughout the Year, representing a year-on-year increase of 21%, and ranked first among the
Top10 real estate enterprises in terms of growth rate; it was awarded the “Chinese Real Estate Leading Brands by
Customer Satisfaction” for 10 consecutive years. In the 2021 Residential Satisfaction Survey, Greentown ranked first
in satisfaction across 14 cities and first in loyalty across 9 cities.

      控制的實體（包括結構性實體）。當本集團              directly or indirectly, controlled by the Company. Control is achieved
      對參與被投資方獲得的可變回報承擔風險               when the Group is exposed, or has rights, to variable returns from its
      或擁有權利，以及能透過對被投資方的權               involvement with the investee and has the ability to affect those returns
      力（即本集團獲賦予現有能力以主導被投資              through its power over the investee (i.e., existing rights that give the
      方相關活動的既存權利）影響該等回報時，              Group the current ability to direct the relevant activities of the investee).
      即獲得控制權。


      倘本公司於被投資方直接或間接擁有的投               When the Company has, directly or indirectly, less than a majority of the
      票權或類似權利未能佔大多數，則在評估               voting or similar rights of an investee, the Group considers all relevant
      本集團於被投資方是否擁有權力時，其會               facts and circumstances in assessing whether it has power over an
      考慮所有相關事實及情況，包括：                  investee, including:                                                            155

      附屬公司的財務報表乃按與本公司相同的               The financial statements of the subsidiaries are prepared for the same
      報告期編製，並採用貫徹一致的會計政                reporting period as the Company, using consistent accounting policies.

                                                          預期信貸虧損的計量取決於違約概                  The measurement of ECL is a function of the probability of default,
                                                          率、違約虧損率（即發生違約時的                  loss given default (i.e. the magnitude of the loss if there is a default)

                                                          概率及違約虧損率根據歷史數據，                  default and loss given default is based on historical data adjusted
                                                          並按前瞻性資料進行調整。預期信                  by forward-looking information. Estimation of ECL reflects an
                                                          貸虧損的估計反映無偏頗及概率加                  unbiased and probability-weighted amount that is determined with
                                                          權金額，其以發生違約風險的金額                  the respective risks of default occurring as the weights. The Group
                                                          作為加權數值而確定。在估計貿易                  uses a practical expedient in estimating ECL on trade receivables
                                                          應收款項評估預期信貸虧損時，本                  using a provision matrix taking into consideration historical credit
208                                                       集團使用可行權宜方法，按歷史信                  loss experience, adjusted by forward-looking information that is

                                                          本或努力即可獲取的前瞻性資料進
                                                          行調整使用撥備矩陣。


                                                          一般而言，預期信貸虧損為根據合                  Generally, the ECL is the difference between all contractual cash

                                                          的實際利率貼現。

                                                          就財務保證合同而言，本集團僅須                  For a financial guarantee contract, the Group is required to

45.   退休福利計劃                         45.     Retirement Benefits Plans
      本集團在中國大陸的附屬公司僱員屬政府                     The employees of the Group’s subsidiaries in Mainland China are
      管理的國家退休福利計劃成員。該些附屬                     members of the state-managed retirement benefits schemes operated
      公司須將發薪的若干百分比向退休福利計                     by the government. These subsidiaries are required to contribute a
      劃供款，以為該等福利提供資金。本集團                     certain percentage of payroll costs to the retirement benefits schemes
      對退休福利計劃的唯一責任是作出所規定                     to fund the benefits. The only obligation of the Group with respect to the
      供款。                                    retirement benefits schemes is to make the specified contributions.
